note: Extra scam rules for ScottPrivacy. The app downloads this file about once a day. Rules only ADD checks; built-in rules always apply. Patterns must work in both Godot (PCRE2) and Java regex. weight: 1-5. when: any | phone_sender.

rules.text: Offers to increase your Fuliza or loan limit. Safaricom never does this from a personal number.
Talks about swapping or upgrading your SIM. Scammers use this to take over your number and M-PESA.
Claims to be about a KRA refund or penalty but came from a personal number.
Says a parcel is waiting and asks you to pay a fee to release it.
Promises guaranteed or very fast returns on money.
